lines:
flowchart TD
 A["Authorize a job-producing capability (shell, python or delegated child) and persist a Chat-owned start intent"] --> B["Start the kind's runner: supervised process tree or in-process child agent loop"]
 B --> C{"Complete before soft wait?"}
 C -->|Yes| D["Return terminal result and acknowledge collected output"]
 C -->|No| E["Return job id, kind, cursor, partial output and running state"]
 E --> F["Agent uses job_output, job_input, job_stop or job_keep"]
 F --> G["Runner retains control after the parent turn ends"]
 G --> F
 G --> H["Persist terminal state and queue the owner completion notice"]
 H --> I["job_output collects the final result"]
 F --> J["Agent proposes final answer"]
 J --> K{"Any running or uncollected jobs?"}
 K -->|Yes| L["Nudge owner to collect, stop or explicitly retain"]
 L --> F
 K -->|No| M["Accept final answer"]
 L --> N["job_keep records deliberate retention; a stopped child scope stays closed"]
 N --> M
 B --> O["User Stop cancels every owned runner; a child job also closes its scope"]
 O --> H
 B --> P["Crash recovery marks previous live jobs interrupted without replay"]

data.title: Chat jobs, soft waits and completion
